name: Kuruwa Kamusabi Episode:02 - Kinky Jakuyaku
original_name: クルワカムサビ EPISODE：02 キンキジャクヤク
source:
He opened his eyes, gathered his whereabouts. It was an unfamiliar part of the city.

The place they call Kamusabi.

Had he fallen asleep? Did someone bring him here? He could remember nothing.
As he look around he met a woman, Akari, offering guidance. She said,

"You may choose the one you like." 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173222.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
他睁开眼睛，探知自己的行踪。这是这座城市的一个陌生的地方。

那个地方被他们称为卡穆萨比（Kamusabi）。

他睡着了吗？有人把他带到这里来了吗？他什么都不记得了。
当他环顾四周时，他遇到了一位名叫Akari的女士，为他提供指导。她说，

“你可以选择你喜欢的一个。” 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE173222.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
